author: CMRobot
description:
ChingMu 1000-Hour Embodied Motion Dataset
	


High-precision optical motion capture data for humanoid robots, dexterous hands, embodied AI, and virtual production.  


	
		




		
Duration
1000+ hours @ 120 Hz


**Scenarios **
15+ real-world scenes


**Tasks **
500+ standardized tasks


Objects
200+ tracked props (6D pose)


Modalities
Skeleton · Finger · Object 6D · Video · Labels


**Formats **
BVH · Retargeted CSV · NPZ


	

✅ Access note: This dataset is fully open and publicly… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/CMRobot/MotionDecode.
